title: Tasawwur-e-shaykh: its purpose
summary: What tasawwur-e-shaykh is, why it is done (so that the thought becomes fixed on one point), and how Hazrat describes its fruits and its cautions. An outline, not instructions.

blocks.p: In part 9 of Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, Hazrat reads the section on tasawwur-e-shaykh. Shaykh, he says, means the murshid: the one you have taken bay'ah with. Tasawwur is holding the shaykh in your thought, thinking of his face, in imagination.

blocks.q: The purpose of Tasawwur-e-Shaykh is that the thought becomes fixed on one point.

blocks.p: He gives an example: 'We are sitting in tasawwur of Qadeer Pia. Now your thought is not going anywhere else: it has become one point.' The same words, the thought on one point, come again in his teaching on i'tikaf and on guarding the gaze.
Hazrat tells how his own pir taught him. Once, sitting in front of him, he was asked:

blocks.q: Do you know my tasawwur? I said: I don't know. He said: Do this. Hold my picture in your mind. Look at me in the picture. That's it. I began from there, and within a few days my eyes opened.

blocks.p: In part 6 he tells the same story, adding that his pir gave him Divine Names to recite with it: Ya Khallaqu, Ya Fa''alu, Ya Musawwiru. 'This is what opened my eyes,' he says. 'I did not need to read books.'

The book describes a thought to hold when fixing the tasawwur: a strong light, like a search-light, coming from Allah to the blessed heart of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, from there into the shaykh's heart, and from the shaykh's heart into one's own heart.

blocks.q: Do not take these as mere imaginings; they are bab-e-futuh, the door of opening. They make one progress, and show wondrous sights.

blocks.p: As the thought grows stronger, Hazrat reads, the murid begins to feel that he is in the shaykh's form. Even outwardly a glimpse of the shaykh is seen in his face, and even the voice becomes alike. The book then names three kinds of sair (journey): in the shaykh; to the Prophet ﷺ in the shaykh; and to Allah in the shaykh.

blocks.q: Becoming aware of people's passing thoughts, and seeing faraway things: these are all matters of a low degree.
Present your kashf to the Qur'an and Hadith. If it agrees, act on it; if it does not, leave it.

blocks.note: Some passages of part 9 are left out of this article: 7:38-9:04 and 16:40-17:12 await the family's decision, and 17:12-18:46 and 23:28-23:47 were not transcribed. Parts 6 to 9 are not yet public on YouTube, so those passages have no video link yet.
Learn this practice from your teacher before doing it.

ru.title: Tasawwur-e-shaykh: iska maqsad
ru.summary: Tasawwur-e-shaykh kya hai, kyun kiya jaata hai (taaki khayal ek nukte par jam jaaye), aur Hazrat iske samraat aur ehtiyaaton ko kaise bayaan karte hain. Sirf khaaka, tareeqa nahin.

blocks.p: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara ke part 9 mein Hazrat tasawwur-e-shaykh wala hissa padhte hain. Shaykh, woh farmate hain, yaani murshid: jinse aapne bay'ah ki hai. Tasawwur yaani shaykh ko apne khayal mein rakhna, unke chehre ka khayal karna, takhayyul mein.

blocks.q: Shaykh ke tasawwur se maqsood khayal ka ek nukte par qaayam hona hai.

blocks.p: Woh ek misaal dete hain: 'Hum Qadeer Pia ke tasawwur mein baithe hain. Ab aapka khayal kahin aur nahin ja raha: ek nukta ban gaya.' Yahi alfaaz, ek nukte par khayal, unki i'tikaf aur nazar ki hifaazat wali ta'leem mein bhi dobara aate hain.

blocks.h: Hazrat ke liye yeh kaise khula

blocks.p: Hazrat batate hain ke unke apne pir ne unko kaise sikhaaya. Ek baar woh unke saamne baithe the to unse poocha gaya:

blocks.q: Mera tasawwur jaante ho? Maine kaha: nahin jaanta. Farmaya: yeh karo. Meri tasveer apne zehan mein rakho. Tasveer mein mujhe dekho. Bas. Maine wahin se shuru kiya, aur kuch hi din mein meri aankhein khul gayin.

blocks.p: Part 6 mein woh yahi waaqia sunaate hain, aur batate hain ke unke pir ne iske saath padhne ke liye unko Asma-e-Ilahi diye: Ya Khallaqu, Ya Fa''alu, Ya Musawwiru. 'Isi ne meri aankhein kholin,' woh farmate hain. 'Mujhe kitaabein padhne ki zaroorat nahin padi.'

Kitaab ek khayal bayaan karti hai jo tasawwur jamaate waqt rakha jaaye: ek tez roshni, search-light ki tarah, Allah ki taraf se Rasoolullah ﷺ ke qalb-e-mubarak tak aati hai, wahaan se shaykh ke dil mein, aur shaykh ke dil se apne dil mein.

blocks.q: Nire khayaalaat mat samjho. Yeh bab-e-futuh hain, yaani kholne ka darwaaza. Yeh taraqqi karaate hain, aur ajeeb-o-ghareeb tamaashe dikhaate hain.

blocks.p: Jaise jaise khayal mazboot hota hai, Hazrat padhte hain, murid ko mehsoos hone lagta hai ke woh shaykh ki soorat mein hai. Zaahiri taur par bhi uske chehre mein shaykh ki jhalak dikhne lagti hai, aur aawaaz bhi milti-julti ho jaati hai. Phir kitaab teen qism ki sair (safar) ka naam leti hai: shaykh mein; shaykh mein Huzoor ﷺ ki taraf; aur shaykh mein Allah ki taraf.

blocks.q: Logon ke khatraat se waaqif ho jaana, aur door door ki cheezein dekhna, yeh sab to adna darje ki baatein hain.
Apne kashf ko Qur'an aur Hadith par pesh karo. Agar mutaabiq ho to amal karo; na ho to chhod do.

blocks.note: Part 9 ke kuch hisse is mazmoon mein shaamil nahin: 7:38-9:04 aur 16:40-17:12 khaandaan ke faisle ke intezaar mein hain, aur 17:12-18:46 aur 23:28-23:47 transcribe nahin hue. Part 6 se 9 abhi YouTube par public nahin hain, isliye in hisson ka video link abhi nahin hai.
Yeh amal karne se pehle apne ustaad/shaykh se seekhiye.
